name: Vladimir Putin
summary: Putin's recorded positions combine a strong, centralised state and presidency with national sovereignty, traditional family and religious values, and opposition to a US-led unipolar order. He holds that Russians and Ukrainians are one people, annexed Crimea and four Ukrainian regions and ordered the 2022 invasion, and signed laws against foreign-funded groups and LGBT propaganda. On the economy he combines market ownership with large state companies and expanding social and family spending.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Repeatedly treats accessible, state-organised medical care as a government duty and commits state funds (over a trillion rubles for health facilities in the 2024 address).

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Raised the minimum wage ahead of inflation (a 50 percent rise from 2020, planned near-doubling to 35,000 rubles by 2030) and proposed a constitutional floor at the subsistence level.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Signed the 2021 two-tier progressive income tax and the 2024 bill with a 22 percent top rate above 50 million rubles plus higher corporate tax; the increases are moderate, hence medium.

property-fundamental.rationale: Calls stability of private property rights the 'alpha and omega' of business and denounces sanctions seizures as violating inviolability of property; in practice his state has also seized assets, noted as tension.

cut-welfare.rationale: Record is expansion, not cutting: maternity capital extended to 2030, pensions indexed above inflation, minimum wage raised. No statement that welfare creates dependency was found.

strong-leader.rationale: Speaks of 'harmony of a strong power and well-being of the people' and the 2020 amendments plus term reset entrenched a strong presidency; no explicit statement about bypassing gridlock.

state-harmful.rationale: Describes Russia as a 'state-civilisation' and insists on a strong state and unconditional sovereignty; his record is centralisation.

empower-police-military.rationale: Directs sustained increases in defence funding and capacity ('we must allocate' for defence industry) and has expanded security services.

decide-locally.rationale: Argues for a unified system of public authority and centralisation, although he also says local self-government powers can be expanded.

traditional-family.rationale: Calls Russia a stronghold of the traditional values and family as the union of a man and a woman; promotes large families.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Signed the 2020 constitutional amendment defining marriage as between a man and a woman; told Europeans to let Russia choose differently from same-sex marriage.

more-religion-public.rationale: Cultivates the Orthodox Church and traditional religions, and the 2020 amendments refer to belief in God.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Calls countering racism 'necessary and noble' but says cancel culture has turned it into reverse racism.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Ridicules 'dozens of genders' and defends the traditional notions of mother, father and gender.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Calls culture, language and traditional identity the foundation of the state and says Russia defends traditional values.

gradual-change.rationale: Says policy will be guided by a 'healthy conservatism' and rejects both a return to the Soviet past and radical liberalism.

nation-first.rationale: Says every leader is responsible first to his compatriots and putting domestic stability above transnational issues is 'normal and correct'.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Says civilian nuclear technology plays a tremendous role that will increase and cites nuclear in Russia's clean energy mix.

revolution-justified.rationale: Denounces colour revolutions and the 2014 Maidan as illegal coups; also criticises the Bolsheviks' acts.

central-planning.rationale: Describes Russia as a market economy without Communist Party power and criticises the Soviet one-size-fits-all approach and deprivation of property.

one-party-rule.rationale: Disavows the Soviet one-party ideology, but has kept one dominant party in power while barring or jailing real opposition; mixed.

democracy-best.rationale: Speaks of Russian democracy, but has kept power through elections without real opposition candidates and jailed or exiled his main challengers; the record wins.

right-to-secede.rationale: Calls Russia's territorial integrity an unconditional red line and blames Lenin's secession right for Soviet collapse, yet backed Crimea's and Donbas's separation from Ukraine.

separate-church-state.rationale: Russia's constitution is secular, but he stresses faith as a source of moral values and works closely with traditional religions.

military-superiority.rationale: Presents new weapons systems as ensuring Russia's security against any defence and orders strengthening of defence industry; speaks of parity and security more than superiority.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Stresses Russia is multi-ethnic and multi-confessional from its beginning and tells nationalists that questioning this destroys the country.

civilizational-union.rationale: Describes Eurasian integration as preserving the identity of peoples of a shared historical space and stresses the Orthodox heritage uniting Russia, Ukraine and Belarus.

limit-population.rationale: His whole demographic policy aims at raising the birth rate; he calls low fertility a national problem.

restore-past-order.rationale: Says there will be no return to Soviet ideology and that conservatives idealising pre-1917 Russia are far from reality.

conscription.rationale: Conscription is in force under him and he ordered a partial mobilisation in September 2022.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Annexed Crimea and four regions; states his goals as protection and historical justice and denies wider imperial aims.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Warns that rising deficits and national debt lead to money printing and inflation (criticising US policy) and calls for responsible financial policy and stable state finances at home.

national-self-determination.rationale: Invokes Article 1 of the UN Charter for Crimea and the annexed regions, but denies Ukraine's separateness as a nation; the principle is stated, application selective.

force-without-un.rationale: His own record includes the 2022 invasion without Security Council approval, though he says (Munich 2007) force is legitimate only via the UN.

dominated-front.rationale: Calls for cooperation with the 'overwhelming majority' of countries against Western hegemony, endorsing BRICS and Eurasian groupings.

national-mission.rationale: Says values and models 'cannot be imposed on anyone' and condemns exporting political systems.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Oversaw the 2016 law restricting missionary activity.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Holds Russia's multi-ethnic character to be its 'genetic code', not a weakness.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Calls civilisational diversity an inherent value and denounces claims of Western exceptionalism.

minority-language-support.rationale: Criticised Kyiv's language policy as infringing minorities' rights and honours the right to speak one's native language.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Rejected adopting a new Constitution, favouring amendments with a national vote.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Showcases Russia's strategic nuclear forces as keeping it independent and notes they are on full combat alert.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Declares annexed regions part of Russia 'forever' and calls territorial integrity non-negotiable; no territorial concessions of homeland are accepted.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Holds that Crimea and the four annexed regions are lawfully part of Russia through the will of residents and signed the accession treaties.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Waged the Chechen war and says separatism destroys the country; denounces Kyiv for using force in Donbas, so application is inconsistent.

flat-income-tax.rationale: His early flat 13 percent tax was replaced under him by a progressive scale in 2021 and extended in 2024; the recent record points against a flat rate.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Justified Crimea and Donbas moves by the Russian and Russian-speaking population living there and claims to protect them.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Argues in a 2021 essay that Russians and Ukrainians are 'one people' sharing language, faith and history, and supports union ties with Belarus.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Repeatedly condemns colonial and hegemonic rule as plunder and arrogance.

patriotic-education.rationale: Insists debates about national identity require patriots, calls for children to learn national history and culture, and wants love for the Fatherland.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Condemns 'reverse discrimination' against the majority in the interests of a minority.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Calls integration with neighbours in the post-Soviet 'Eurasian space' an 'absolute priority' and pursues the Eurasian Economic Union.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Urges wealthy businesspeople to invest in schools, healthcare and culture and tells them to serve compatriots.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Says the West runs a neo-colonial system that collects 'tribute' from the world through dollar and technological dominance.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Argues Crimea and the south-east are historically Russian land wrongly given to Soviet Ukraine and acted to reverse it.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Argues each civilisation develops its own political system and values and rejects imposing Western models.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Signed the foreign-agent laws and later extensions restricting foreign-funded NGOs and media, which he defends as protection against outside interference.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Calls the demographic situation an emergency, extends maternity capital to 2030, and asks 'Do you want to survive on account of immigrants?' about Europe's low birth rates.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Proposed and secured the 2020 amendment that international law and bodies' decisions apply only so far as they do not contradict the Russian Constitution.

religious-nation.rationale: Describes Russia as multi-confessional from its beginning.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Rejects the West's demand that states act as vassals or 'suzerain' followers.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Treats the Holocaust as established fact and cites the killing of 1.5 million Jews in Ukraine.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Adult same-sex relations were decriminalised in 1993 and he has not re-criminalised them, though the 2013 and 2022 propaganda laws and the 2023 extremism designation penalise promotion and the movement.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Record: foreign-agent, treason, anti-extremism and assembly laws penalise dissent and independent organisations. He frames this as defending sovereignty, not as a stated aim of suppression.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Signed the 2023 law ending legal gender change and banning gender-affirming care, and the 2022 extension of propaganda ban.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Record is expansion of the armed forces and defence industry.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Treats faith and traditional religions as foundations of national identity.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Russia's nuclear forces are based on its own territory under his command.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Presents Russian statehood and identity as continuous from the baptism of Rus and 'thousand-year' history to now.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Defends traditional notions of gender and sex in opposition to Western reforms.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Says progress is impossible without spiritual, cultural and national self-determination and discusses moral and spiritual questions of technology.

language-defines-nation.rationale: His unity thesis treats a shared language and history as making Russians and Ukrainians one people whatever borders divide them.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: States that the West wants to weaken Russia and make it 'dependent, declining and dying' or destroy it from within or outside.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Says 'contaminators must pay' for recycling costs of goods and packaging.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Calls for rules of the world economy not written by a few and a 'post-hegemonic' order.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Maintains and modernises the arsenal while criticising US policy; no unilateral disarmament.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Rejects the ICC; Russia does not recognise its March 2023 arrest warrant for him.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Justifies Crimea and the four annexations by referendums of residents; the votes were held under occupation and he does not extend it to other Ukrainian regions.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Frames the intervention as protecting compatriots and Russian speakers in Ukraine.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: Pursues technological sovereignty (AI, genetics) alongside defence of traditional values.

multipolar-world.rationale: Has argued since Munich 2007 against a unipolar world and promotes multipolar centres of power.

notes: Stated views and practice conflict in places: he calls Russia a democracy and invokes self-determination, while the record shows suppression of opposition and denial of Ukraine's separateness. Where positions changed, the recent clear one is used (e.g. a flat 13 percent income tax early on, progressive scale since 2021; openness to the West in 2000s vs later hostility). The FT 2019 interview and Direct Line transcripts were not opened, so nothing is cited from them. Several other answers rely on his legislative record via Wikipedia.
